search.label: Search for your home's address
search.help: Type a street, a neighbourhood or a town. Pick a result to place the pin.
search.found: {count, plural, one {# address found.} other {# addresses found.}} Use the up and down arrow keys, then Enter, to choose one.
search.none: Nothing matches that. Try fewer words, or move the pin on the map yourself.
search.unavailable: Address search can't be reached right now. You can still use your device's location or move the pin on the map.

device.found: Pin moved to your device's location.
device.denied: Your device's location isn't available, and that's fine. Search for your address above, or move the pin on the map.

map.label: Map of your home's location
map.hint: Drag the pin, or tap the map, to put it on your home.
map.unsupported: The map can't be shown on this device. Searching for your address above is all you need.

outside.title: This pin is outside Indonesia
outside.body: SuryaPas only works out homes in Indonesia. Move the pin onto your home, or search for a different address.
